correctness.rationale: The 23 per-shore saturation signatures faithfully preserve threshold-two excitation predicates while tagged original color classes preserve microscopic least periods. Exhaustive enumeration of all 23^2=529 classes verifies periods only 1,3,4 and first entry no later than 5. The 52 period-four signatures yield the displayed four-by-four exact coefficient matrix; H_n is proved by inclusion-exclusion. The independent labelled-state checker verifies all 1,327,590 configurations in eight graph sizes. The finite symbolic quotient, not the finite small-graph simulations, supplies the all-size proof. Sharp witnesses and boundary sizes have been checked.

value.rationale: This is an exact natural dynamical invariant of an infinite two-parameter graph family: all three period basin counts, orbit counts, sharp temporal cutoff and two distinct sharp size thresholds for recurrence. The strong contrast between four-cycle onset at shore size four and three-cycle onset at six, and asymptotic almost-sure three-cycle attraction, are motivated structural phenomena not implied by generic finite-state periodicity or routine substitution. The complete quotient and small closed formulas are reusable for studying excitation phase-space geometry.
